shared_elements: carved stone surface with low-relief motifs
linear incised detail suggesting garment or texture
justification: Both are stone monuments carrying an anthropomorphic figure worked in shallow relief, and both include round disc-like motifs (a plain boss on the chest in A, floral rosettes in B), which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a bulky, heavily weathered three-dimensional block with frontally arranged, barely legible schematic motifs, whereas B is a flat rectangular slab with a crisp, fluent profile figure and finely incised plant forms filling the field — different modes of carving and different compositional logic.
